messages:
Ajay Patel: kicking off catalog enable for model redwood-rlhf-v2 in us-east-1. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m soak at each step. Fallback ordering should be: quant-lite -> fullfp16 -> redwood-rlhf-v1. Change window 10:30-11:30 UTC. tagging @Sophie to monitor.

deploy-bot: starting enable job enable-2245999999-01 region=us-east-1 model=redwood-rlhf-v2 canary=5%

Sophie Liu: ack. I'll watch 95p latency and 5xx rate. Gate thresholds: 95p < 120ms, 5xx < 1% of requests. If either exceeds, we rollback to pinned v1 immediately.

Ken Rivera: added note — I locked EU catalog pin to v1 earlier to avoid mismatch with downstream rules. So EU will not be auto-enabled until pin cleared. I put a comment in the pinlist.

Maria Gomez: quick question on fallbacks — does quant-lite share the same KV cache layout? if not we might see cold KVs on switch.

Ajay Patel: good point. quant-lite preserves KV layout; fullfp16 also compatible. Only fallback to v1 will cause full kv warmup. plan: if we hit any fallback to v1 we will run a short warmup task: curl -s https://internal/warmup?model=redwood-rlhf-v1 &

deploy-bot: canary 5% complete -> success. metrics: p95=105ms, error_rate=0.45% :thumbsup:

Sophie Liu: seeing a ~9ms bump on p50 in us-east at canary start, p95 holding. no anomalous 5xx. continuing.

Ken Rivera: raising to 25% now per rollout plan. I updated catalog->traffic: "redwood-rlhf-v2": 25, fallback_order: ["quant-lite","fullfp16","redwood-rlhf-v1"]

Ajay Patel: hold on increasing globally — I'm seeing a small CPU jitter on a subset of hosts in us-east. If p95 crosses 140ms or 5xx > 1% for >2m, we cut. Sophie, please set ephemeral alert: alert if p95>140ms or 5xx>1% for 2m.

Sophie Liu: set alert. also posting a quick dashboard link: https://dashboards/redwood/rollouts/2245999999

deploy-bot: step to 25% started.

Sophie Liu: 25% soak 6m in. p95 stable at 112ms, error_rate 0.6%. no obvious spikes.

Ajay Patel: OK proceed to 100% in us-east. remember EU is still pinned to v1 — do not touch EU. Ken, can you open TI to reconcile pinlist and EU schedule?

Ken Rivera: opened TI-482: "Reconcile EU pinlist for rlhf-v2 enable". assigning to infra.

deploy-bot: enable complete in us-east: 100% traffic -> model redwood-rlhf-v2. EU: paused due to pin conflict. job=enable-2245999999-01 status=complete region=us-east-1

Ajay Patel: thanks team. post-mortem / follow-up: 1) confirm warmup job for v1 in case of emergency fallback, 2) update rollout runbook with the KV compatibility note, 3) schedule EU cutover after pin reconciliation. I'll file notes in the rollout doc. :white_check_mark:
